d: Industry: Food & Beverage / FMCG / Wholesale Distribution
We are recruiting an experienced and commercially minded Operations Manager on behalf of an established, growing Dubai-based food importation and wholesale distribution business.

This is a senior, hands-on position offering full responsibility for the company's day-to-day operations, including international imports, supply chain management, warehousing, inventory control, logistics and wholesale distribution.

Reporting directly to the business owner, the successful candidate will take ownership of operational performance, manage teams and external suppliers, improve efficiencies and ensure the business is structured to support continued growth.
q: Proven experience as an Operations Manager, Head of Operations or similar senior operational leader.
Strong background in food importation, FMCG, wholesale distribution or food supply chain operations .
Demonstrable experience managing international imports, warehousing, inventory and logistics.
Good knowledge of UAE customs procedures, food import regulations and supply chain requirements.
Experience handling chilled, frozen or temperature-sensitive food products would be advantageous.
Strong leadership skills, with experience managing operational teams and external suppliers.
Commercial awareness and a track record of improving operational efficiency and controlling costs.
Experience within a growing SME or owner-managed business would be particularly beneficial.
Highly organised, proactive and capable of independently managing multiple operational functions.
This position offers considerable autonomy and the opportunity to take full ownership of operations within a growing food distribution business.
The successful candidate will work directly with the owner, playing a central role in strengthening operational processes, managing the supply chain and supporting the company's continued expansion.
